Arguments shared by several functions

Source: R/scmp-params.R
scmp-params.Rd

The arguments that several functions of the package take, documented once and inherited by the help page of each function.

Arguments

scmpObj

A ScMaSigPro object.

verbose

Whether to print progress messages.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallelParam object that runs the per-gene fits, such as BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(2) (Linux and macOS) or BiocParallel::SnowParam(2) (any system). The default, BiocParallel::SerialParam(), fits the genes one after another; create it with progressbar = TRUE for a progress bar. The results do not depend on the backend.

ptime_col

The name of the column of the cell metadata that holds the pseudotime of each cell.

path_col

The name of the column of the cell or bin metadata that holds the path label of each cell or bin.

bin_ptime_col

The name of the column of the bin metadata that holds the binned pseudotime of each bin.

bin_col

The name of the column of the bin metadata that holds the name of each bin.

bin_size_col

The name of the column of the bin metadata that holds the number of cells of each bin.

bin_mem_col

The name of the column of the bin metadata that holds the cells of each bin, separated by |.

assay_name

The name of the assay of the Sparse slot that holds the counts of the cells.

aggregate

How the counts of the cells of a bin are combined: "sum" or "mean" (rounded to whole numbers).

includeInflu

Whether to keep the genes with influential observations (see showInflu()).

feature_id

The name of a gene.
